QUOTE: `skipSync: true` does two things. In `sanitizeReactions` it returns before computing deletions, so it never removes other reactions on the post. ... This is the reason the WebSocket path can carry only one reaction and not wipe the rest.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that skipSync prevents deletion of other reactions on the post, so the single-reaction WebSocket payload doesn't wipe the rest.
